# Quote package preparation (FPGA-01/5) -- distributor-agnostic

Purpose: make the **blocked assembly-quote gate** maximally prepared so that
a single interactive session (account + upload) can finish it later. No
account, login, purchase or file submission was performed or is possible
from here; the quote itself remains **NOT OBTAINED** (ordered FPGA-01/5,
no waiver recorded).

## Contents (generated by `tools/quote_prep.py`, re-runnable)

| file | what | provenance |
|---|---|---|
| `bom_neutral.csv` | distributor-agnostic BOM, 10 line items / 35 refs | expanded from `docs/bom.json` (evidence fetched 2026-10-14) + board `Value` strings cross-checked (tool self-check S4) |
| `cpl_gw1nz_provisional.csv` | JLC-style pick-and-place list (JLC/LCSC column conventions), same 35 refs | positions lifted from `out/kicad/tile_gw1nz.kicad_pcb` r6 (sha256[:12] `c7d5b66fa1db`, the validator-snapshotted artifact) |

Self-checks in the tool: S1 pcb census == 65 footprints; S2 bom.json
expanded refs == pcb BOM-bearing refs (19 JP contact pads + 11 TP test
points are copper board features, NOT assembly items, and are excluded by
design); S3 our own CSV re-parse == BOM refs; S4 board `Value` strings ==
commodity expectations (100n/1u/4u7/1k/4k7/0R/FB-class).

## Honest labels (do not strip when re-using)

- **PROVISIONAL placement**: the board is an unrouted placement prototype
  (0 tracks, 99 unconnected items at r6 -- FPGA-02 owns routing). The CPL
  positions are generator-source-of-truth for the prototype, useful for
  quote *structure* only. After routing, re-export the authoritative CPL
  from KiCad itself (`kicad-cli pcb export pos`) -- rotation conventions
  for bottom-side parts are KiCad's business, not this CSV's.
- The BOM is **neutral on purpose**: primary evidence is LCSC/DigiKey/
  kailhswitch.net lines; every commodity line is distributor-free so the
  same file feeds JLC's BOM matcher, LCSC, DigiKey or Mouser import
  without editing. Kailh sockets carry the consigned/hand-solder note.

## To actually obtain the quote later (checklist, needs an account)

1. Fabrication files from the ROUTED board (FPGA-02 acceptance first):
   Gerbers + drill from the final `.kicad_pcb` (`kicad-cli pcb export
   gerbers/drill`), then this CSV pair regenerated.
2. Upload BOM + CPL; confirm fine-pitch capability: QFN-48 0.4 mm is
   within the published ">=0.35 mm" bound (evidence in `docs/bom.md`).
3. Consigned line: SW1..SW12 (Kailh CPG151101S11) -- not in PCBA
   libraries; select consign/hand-solder in the quote flow.
4. Review placement review screen, stencil option, EP paste for the QFN
   EPAD (thermal-via decision still open, see `docs/readiness.md`).
5. Record the formal quote back into `docs/bom.json`/`docs/bom.md` and
   the FPGA-01 checkpoint; only then is sub-gate 5 closable.

Component roll-up stays ~US$9.6/tile at qty 1 (docs/bom.md); the PCBA
line item is unquoted by design of this note.
